$comment: Allow-list contract for the public web artifact of teknoify.com. Only files reachable from the entries below (plus the public/ overlay) may enter the artifact. See docs/marketing-rebuild/05-production-boundary-and-legacy-exit.md.

transitionalPages.$comment: Legacy authentication / premium-gated pages kept ONLY during the migration window. Each has a sunset condition in doc 05 §7. They are never listed in the sitemap.
transitionalPages.reset-password.html: Firebase email action handler; remove after the Firebase Auth action URL points at platform.teknoify.com (U4).
transitionalPages.pages/investment-retail.html: Premium-gated preview linked from investment-analytics; remove when the platform hosts investment analytics.
transitionalPages.pages/investment-airlines.html: Premium-gated preview linked from investment-analytics; remove when the platform hosts investment analytics.

transitionalFiles.$comment: Legacy auth scripts still referenced by public pages. Referencing pages must drop them in the legacy-exit step; the build reports them on every run.
transitionalFiles.js/session-manager.js: Firebase compat session timer + impersonation bar; referenced by index.html and pages/*.html.
transitionalFiles.js/premium-content-gate.js: Firebase role gate for premium previews; referenced by investment and subscription pages.

staticFiles.$comment: Files fetched at runtime by JavaScript through variables the crawler cannot follow. Listed explicitly so data exposure is a deliberate decision.

forbidden.$comment: Structural guards. A reference from a public page to any of these fails the build; any such file found in the output fails verification.

contentMarkers.$comment: Byte patterns that must never appear in any artifact file.
